question: Should OpenClaw adopt `agents.run`, `phase`, and `log` as a supported permanent QuickJS Code Mode API once the event-contract defects and runtime proof are resolved?
rationale: This is an opt-in but user-facing orchestration capability with a new typed Code Mode contract and persisted replay behavior; maintainers must choose the durable API and UI/event semantics.

options.title: Sponsor and narrow the API
options.body: Keep the opt-in Swarm direction, first separate note metadata from canonical session fields, wire phases into the dashboard model, and require restart-flow proof.

options.title: Pause the public surface
options.body: Keep the underlying Swarm capability private until maintainers define the supported Code Mode API and client event contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and narrow the API
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in Swarm direction, first separate note metadata from canonical session fields, wire phases into the dashboard model, and require restart-flow proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete authored the feature design and current implementation, so they are the closest available routing candidate for a sponsorship discussion.
